server_picker.title: Page heading of the Server Picker page. {game} = game name, e.g. "Deadlock". Keep the game name untranslated.
server_picker.subtitle: Page subtitle under the Server Picker heading. Explains that turning a region's toggle on blocks it from matchmaking.
server_picker.presets_button: Button in the Server Picker header that opens the presets dialog. Keep short, about 8 characters.
server_picker.ping_button: Button in the Server Picker header that measures the direct ping to each region. Keep short, about 6 characters.
server_picker.unblock_all_button: Button in the Server Picker header that removes all blocks. {count} = number of blocked regions, e.g. 3. Keep short, about 16 characters.
server_picker.filter_placeholder: Placeholder text in the region search box on the Server Picker page.
server_picker.filter_aria: Screen reader label for the region search box on the Server Picker page.
server_picker.loading: Loading message shown on the Server Picker page while the server list loads.
server_picker.no_games: Error message on the Server Picker page when the server list cannot be loaded. Contains the app name Deadlock+, keep it untranslated.
server_picker.no_match: Empty state in the region list when the search finds nothing. {search} = text the user typed, e.g. "Tokyo".
server_picker.external_fallback: Name used for another firewall tool when its real name is unknown. Fills {source} in the import dialog and toast.
server_picker.unsupported: Warning banner on the Server Picker page. {platform} = operating system name, e.g. "macOS".

unblock_all.title: Title of the confirm dialog for removing all server blocks.
unblock_all.description: Body of the unblock all confirm dialog. {count} = number of firewall rules, e.g. 3. Plural forms. Contains the app name Deadlock+, keep it untranslated.
unblock_all.confirm: Confirm button in the unblock all dialog. Keep short, about 11 characters.

import.title: Title of the confirm dialog for importing blocks made by another tool. {source} = name of that tool, e.g. "Other tool".
import.description: Body of the import dialog. Contains the app name Deadlock+, keep it untranslated. {source} = name of the other tool, e.g. "Other tool".
import.confirm: Confirm button in the import blocks dialog. Keep short, about 6 characters.

ping.ms: Ping value shown next to a region. {value} = number of milliseconds, e.g. "42". Keep short, about 7 characters.
ping.no_reply: Ping cell text when the region never answered. Keep short, about 8 characters.

external.summary: Banner text saying another tool already blocks regions. {rules} = rule count text, e.g. "2 Foo rules". {regions} = region count text, e.g. "3 regions".
external.rules: Rule count inside the banner summary. Plural forms. {count} = number of rules, e.g. 2. {label} = name of the other tool, e.g. "Other tool".
external.regions: Region count inside the banner summary. Plural forms. {count} = number of regions, e.g. 3.
external.import: Button in the banner that imports blocks made by another tool. Keep short, about 6 characters.

game_running.title: Heading of a warning banner on the Server Picker page. Deadlock is the game name, keep it untranslated.
game_running.body: Body of the warning banner shown while the game is running. Tells the user to restart the game after changes.

sort.by: Screen reader label for a sortable column header. {label} = column name, e.g. "Region".
sort.ascending: Screen reader label for the sort direction arrow in a column header. Lowercase word.
sort.descending: Screen reader label for the sort direction arrow in a column header. Lowercase word.
sort.region: Table column header in the server list for the region name. Keep short, about 6 characters.
sort.ping: Table column header in the server list for the direct ping. Keep short, about 11 characters.
sort.blocked: Table column header in the server list for the blocked switch. Keep short, about 7 characters.

presets.title: Title of the presets dialog on the Server Picker page.
presets.description: Description in the presets dialog. Explains saving a set of regions to block or keep open and applying it in one click.
presets.edit_title: Title of the presets dialog while editing an existing preset.
presets.new_title: Title of the presets dialog while creating a new preset.
presets.edit_description: Description in the preset editor. Warns that applying a preset sets every region and clears single server blocks.
presets.name_placeholder: Placeholder text in the preset name input. The example name is "EU only" (Europe), translate the example.
presets.name_aria: Screen reader label for the preset name input.
presets.mode_aria: Screen reader label for the radio group choosing the preset mode.
presets.mode_allow_title: Radio option title in the preset editor. The listed regions stay open and the rest are blocked. Keep short, about 16 characters.
presets.mode_allow_note: Short note under the allow mode option in the preset editor.
presets.mode_block_title: Radio option title in the preset editor. The listed regions get blocked. Keep short, about 16 characters.
presets.mode_block_note: Short note under the block mode option in the preset editor.
presets.filter_placeholder: Placeholder text in the region search box inside the preset editor.
presets.filter_aria: Screen reader label for the region search box inside the preset editor.
presets.will_block: Summary line in the preset editor. {blocked} = regions blocked, e.g. 5. {total} = all regions, e.g. 12. {open} = regions left open, e.g. 7.
presets.summary_allow: Summary line for a preset in the presets list. {listed} = regions kept open, e.g. 3. {blocked} = regions blocked, e.g. 9. {total} = all regions, e.g. 12.
presets.summary_block: Summary line for a preset in the presets list. {listed} = regions listed as blocked, e.g. 3. {blocked} = regions blocked, e.g. 3. {total} = all regions, e.g. 12.
presets.back: Button in the preset editor that returns to the presets list without saving. Keep short, about 4 characters.
presets.save: Button in the preset editor that saves the preset. Keep short, about 11 characters.
presets.apply: Button on a preset row in the presets list that applies it. Keep short, about 5 characters.
presets.edit_label: Screen reader and tooltip label for the edit icon button on a preset row. {name} = preset name, e.g. "EU only".
presets.delete_label: Screen reader and tooltip label for the delete icon button on a preset row. {name} = preset name, e.g. "EU only".
presets.empty: Empty state in the presets dialog when no presets exist.
presets.save_current: Button in the presets dialog that saves the currently blocked regions as a new preset. Keep short, about 20 characters.
presets.new: Button in the presets dialog that starts a blank preset. Keep short, about 10 characters.
presets.apply_label: Screen reader label for the apply button on a preset row. {name} = preset name, e.g. "EU only".

row.relay_groups: Badge on a region row showing how many server groups it holds. Plural forms. {count} = number, e.g. 3. Keep short, about 14 characters.
row.relays: Badge text for the number of servers in a region. Plural forms. {count} = number, e.g. 3. Keep short, about 11 characters.
row.partial: Badge on a region row when only some servers are blocked. {blocked} = blocked servers, e.g. 1. {total} = all servers, e.g. 3. Keep short, about 13 characters.
row.routing_aria: Screen reader label for the info icon on a region row that opens a routing tooltip. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
row.unblockable: Line in the routing tooltip of a region row. {names} = list of region names, e.g. "Dubai, Mumbai". Valve is a company name.
row.block_siblings: Clickable link in the routing tooltip that also blocks nearby regions. {names} = list of region names, e.g. "Dubai, Mumbai".
row.no_reply_hint: Tooltip on a ping cell when the region never answered.
row.ping_region: Tooltip on a ping cell for a region row with several servers.
row.ping_relay: Tooltip on a ping cell for a single server row.
row.applying: Screen reader label for a spinner shown while a block is being applied to the firewall.
row.blocked: Status text next to a switch on a region row when it is blocked. Keep short, about 7 characters.
row.open: Status text next to a switch on a region row when it is not blocked. Keep short, about 4 characters.
row.block_aria: Screen reader label for the block switch on a region row. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
row.locked: Tooltip on a disabled block switch of a single server. {region} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
row.expand_aria: Screen reader label for the expander button on a region row. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
row.collapse_aria: Screen reader label for the collapse button on a region row. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
row.ping_aria: Screen reader label for a ping cell. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt". {ping} = ping text, e.g. "42 ms" or "No reply".

toast.refresh_failed: Error toast on the Server Picker page when the server list could not be refreshed.
toast.firewall_read_failed: Error toast on the Server Picker page when current firewall rules could not be read.
toast.relays_moved: Info toast. Valve changed its servers and the app updated the user's blocks. {names} = region names, e.g. "Dubai, Mumbai".
toast.blocks_update_failed: Error toast when blocks could not be updated after Valve changed its servers. {names} = region names, e.g. "Dubai, Mumbai".
toast.sync_failed: Error toast when the app could not compare user blocks with Valve's latest server list.
toast.unsupported: Error toast when the user tries to block servers on a system that does not support it.
toast.blocked: Success toast after blocking a region. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
toast.unblocked: Success toast after unblocking a region. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
toast.block_failed: Error toast when blocking a region failed. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
toast.unblock_failed: Error toast when unblocking a region failed. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
toast.siblings_failed: Error toast when blocking the related regions failed.
toast.unblocked_rules: Success toast after removing all blocks. Plural forms. {count} = number of rules, e.g. 3.
toast.unblock_all_failed: Error toast when removing all blocks failed.
toast.preset_applied: Success toast after applying a preset. {name} = preset name, e.g. "EU only". {blocked} = regions blocked, e.g. 9. {total} = all regions, e.g. 12.
toast.preset_apply_failed: Error toast when applying a preset failed. {name} = preset name, e.g. "EU only".
toast.preset_saved: Success toast after saving a preset. {name} = preset name, e.g. "EU only".
toast.preset_save_failed: Error toast when saving a preset failed.
toast.preset_delete_failed: Error toast when deleting a preset failed.
toast.imported: Success toast after importing blocks from another tool. Plural forms. {count} = number of blocks, e.g. 2. {source} = name of the other tool.
toast.import_failed: Error toast when importing blocks from another tool failed.

admin_needed.block: Title of the admin access dialog or error toast when blocking a region fails. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
admin_needed.unblock: Title of the admin access dialog or error toast when unblocking a region fails. {name} = region name, e.g. "Frankfurt".
admin_needed.siblings: Title of the admin access dialog or error toast when blocking related regions fails.
admin_needed.unblock_all: Title of the admin access dialog or error toast when removing all blocks fails.
admin_needed.preset: Title of the admin access dialog or error toast when applying a preset fails. {name} = preset name, e.g. "EU only".
admin_needed.import: Title of the admin access dialog or error toast when importing blocks fails.
admin_needed.description: Body of the admin access dialog. Contains the app name Deadlock+, keep it untranslated. "Allow" and "Always allow" must match the dialog's button labels.

server_picker.load_failed: Error message. Shown on the server picker when the list of game servers could not be loaded.

state.game_closed: Status headline on the Live page when the game is not running. Deadlock is the game name, keep it untranslated.
state.menus: Status headline on the Live page when the player is in the game menus.
state.queuing: Status headline on the Live page while the player is queuing for a match.
state.pregame: Status headline on the Live page while the match is about to start (hero select).
state.in_match: Status headline on the Live page while a match is in progress.
state.post_match: Status headline on the Live page after a match ended.
state.game_closed_hint: Short hint under the Live page status headline when the game is closed.
state.menus_hint: Short hint under the Live page status headline when the player is in the menus.
state.queuing_hint: Short hint under the Live page status headline while queuing.
state.pregame_hint: Short hint under the Live page status headline before the match starts. Heroes are Deadlock game terms.
state.in_match_hint: Short hint under the Live page status headline during a match while data is being read.
state.post_match_hint: Short hint under the Live page status headline after a match ended.
state.loading_match: Status headline on the Live page while match data is loading.
state.loading_match_hint: Short hint under the loading headline on the Live page.

team.amber: Team name on the Live page for the Amber side. It is a Deadlock game term, match the game's own translation. Also used as the team table's screen reader label.
team.sapphire: Team name on the Live page for the Sapphire side. It is a Deadlock game term, match the game's own translation. Also used as the team table's screen reader label.

mode.unranked: Match mode badge in the Live page match header. Keep short, about 8 characters.
mode.ranked: Match mode badge in the Live page match header. Keep short, about 6 characters.
mode.privateLobby: Match mode badge in the Live page match header for a private lobby. Keep short, about 7 characters.
mode.coopBot: Match mode badge in the Live page match header for a match against bots. Keep short, about 6 characters.
mode.tutorial: Match mode badge in the Live page match header for the tutorial. Keep short, about 8 characters.
mode.other: Match mode badge in the Live page match header for an unknown mode. Keep short, about 5 characters.

game.normal: Game mode badge in the Live page match header for the standard game mode. Keep short, about 8 characters.
game.streetBrawl: Game mode name in the Live page match header and match history filters. Street Brawl is a Deadlock game term, match the game's own translation.
game.sandbox: Game mode badge in the Live page match header. Sandbox is a Deadlock game term, match the game's own translation. Keep short, about 7 characters.
game.exploreNyc: Game mode badge in the Live page match header. Explore NYC is a Deadlock game term, match the game's own translation. Keep short, about 11 characters.
game.other: Game mode badge in the Live page match header for an unknown mode. Keep short, about 5 characters.

col.rank: Table column header in the Live page team table for player rank. Keep short, about 4 characters.
col.souls: Table column header in the Live page team table for total souls. Souls is a Deadlock game term, match the game. Keep short, about 5 characters.
col.souls_per_min: Table column header (tooltip or screen reader name) in the Live page team table for souls per minute. Souls is a Deadlock game term.
col.kills: Table column header in the Live page team table for kills. Part of the kills, deaths, assists group. Keep short, about 5 characters.
col.deaths: Table column header in the Live page team table for deaths. Part of the kills, deaths, assists group. Keep short, about 6 characters.
col.assists: Table column header in the Live page team table for assists. Part of the kills, deaths, assists group. Keep short, about 7 characters.
col.kill_participation: Table column header (tooltip or screen reader name) in the Live page team table for kill participation percentage.
col.hero_damage: Table column header (tooltip or screen reader name) in the Live page team table for damage dealt to heroes. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
col.objective_damage: Table column header (tooltip or screen reader name) in the Live page team table for damage dealt to objectives such as Walkers and Guardians.
col.healing: Table column header (tooltip or screen reader name) in the Live page team table for healing done. Keep short, about 7 characters.

live.rank_from_history: Tooltip on a rank badge in the Live page team table. {rank} = rank name, e.g. "Archon 3". Ranks are Deadlock game terms, match the game.
live.paused: Screen reader label for the pause icon next to the match clock on the Live page. Keep short, about 6 characters.

queue.party: Tooltip on the party size count shown while queuing on the Live page.

swaps.line: Notice line on the Live page when a player changed hero. {from} = old hero, e.g. "Haze". {to} = new hero, e.g. "Seven". Heroes are Deadlock game terms.
swaps.named: Notice line on the Live page when a player changed hero. {name} = player name, e.g. "Sammi". {from} = old hero, e.g. "Haze". {to} = new hero, e.g. "Seven". Heroes are game terms.
swaps.dismiss: Screen reader label for the close button of the hero change notice on the Live page.

label.overall: Label on the overall grade tile in the Live page grade strip. Keep short, about 7 characters.
label.kills: Label on a grade tile in the Live page grade strip. Keep short, about 5 characters.
label.deaths: Label on a grade tile in the Live page grade strip. Keep short, about 6 characters.
label.assists: Label on a grade tile in the Live page grade strip. Keep short, about 7 characters.
label.souls: Label on a grade tile in the Live page grade strip for souls per minute. Souls is a Deadlock game term. Keep short, about 10 characters.
label.damage: Label on a grade tile in the Live page grade strip for damage per minute. Keep short, about 8 characters.
label.objective_damage: Label on a grade tile in the Live page grade strip for objective damage per minute. Keep short, about 12 characters.
label.healing: Label on a grade tile in the Live page grade strip. Keep short, about 7 characters.

name.kills: Full stat name in the grade tile tooltip on the Live page.
name.deaths: Full stat name in the grade tile tooltip on the Live page.
name.assists: Full stat name in the grade tile tooltip on the Live page.
name.souls: Full stat name in the grade tile tooltip on the Live page. Souls is a Deadlock game term.
name.damage: Full stat name in the grade tile tooltip on the Live page.
name.objective_damage: Full stat name in the grade tile tooltip on the Live page. Objectives are things like Walkers and Guardians, Deadlock game terms.
name.healing: Full stat name in the grade tile tooltip on the Live page.

grades.too_early: Short value shown on a grade tile when a grade cannot be given yet. Keep short, about 9 characters.
grades.too_early_long: Tooltip line on a grade tile saying the match is too early to give a grade.
grades.after_first_minute: Short note on the Live page grade strip. Grades appear once the match clock passes 1:00. Keep the time format.
grades.no_targets: Short note on the Live page grade strip when no comparison targets are available.
grades.frozen: Short note on the Live page grade strip. The comparison targets stopped updating.
grades.loading: Short note on the Live page grade strip while comparison targets load.
grades.avg: Tiny label on the grade bar marking the average position. Keep short, about 3 characters.
grades.average: Tooltip line on a grade tile. {value} = average stat value, e.g. "12.5".
grades.better_than: Tooltip line on a grade tile. {pct} = percentage of players, e.g. 72. The percent sign is already in the text.
grades.fewer_deaths: Tooltip line on the deaths grade tile. {pct} = percentage of players, e.g. 72. The percent sign is already in the text.
grades.self_heal: Tooltip line on the healing grade tile. {n} = healing amount on yourself, e.g. "1,200".
grades.healing_teammates: Tooltip line on the healing grade tile. {n} = healing amount on teammates, e.g. "3,400".

group.rank: Tooltip line on a grade tile naming the comparison group. {hero} = hero name, e.g. "Haze". {rank} = rank name, e.g. "Archon". Hero and ranks are Deadlock game terms.
group.range: Tooltip line on a grade tile naming the comparison group. {hero} = hero name, e.g. "Haze". {rankFrom} and {rankTo} = rank names, e.g. "Emissary", "Archon". Game terms.
group.all_ranks: Tooltip line on a grade tile naming the comparison group. {hero} = hero name, e.g. "Haze". Hero is a Deadlock game term.
group.street_brawl: Tooltip line on a grade tile naming the comparison group. {hero} = hero name, e.g. "Haze". Hero and Street Brawl are Deadlock game terms.

reason.offline: Note on the Live page grade strip explaining why no comparison targets are available. The user's internet looks down.
reason.api_down: Note on the Live page grade strip explaining why no targets are available. Deadlock API is a name, keep Deadlock untranslated.
reason.rate_limited: Note on the Live page grade strip explaining why no targets are available. Deadlock API is a name, keep Deadlock untranslated.
reason.empty_data: Note on the Live page grade strip explaining why no targets are available. Deadlock API is a name, keep Deadlock untranslated. Hero is a game term.

ptrace.title: Heading of a warning card on the Live page for Linux users. Deadlock+ is the app name, keep it untranslated.
ptrace.body: Body text of the Linux warning card on the Live page. ptrace is a Linux kernel feature name, keep it untranslated.
ptrace.fix: Button on the Linux warning card that changes the ptrace setting. Keep short, about 12 characters.
ptrace.fix_restart: Button on the Linux warning card that changes the ptrace setting and restarts. Keep short, about 25 characters.
ptrace.reboot: Small note on the Linux warning card saying a computer restart is needed.
ptrace.manual: Small note on the Linux warning card for setups the app cannot fix. Steam, Flatpak and Snap are product names, keep them untranslated. Deadlock+ is the app name.
ptrace.failed: Error toast shown when changing the ptrace setting failed. ptrace is a Linux kernel feature name, keep it untranslated.

game_admin.title: Heading of a warning card on the Live page. Deadlock is the game name, keep it untranslated. It describes a temporary state.
game_admin.body: Body of the warning card on the Live page. Steam is a product name, keep it untranslated.
